### BEFORE YOU REPORT A BUG:
- Make sure that your game is working without any mods installed.
- If you have any other mods installed, please first delete (NOT disable, DELETE) the other mods and confirm that the issue is still happening.
- If you altered the mod's files in any way before or after installing it, you need to first confirm that the same issue would still happen if you didn't mess with it. I cannot give support for your custom rig.
- Please be patient, if I don't reply to your bug report I'm not ignoring you but may have other important things to take care of at the moment.
- Stadium 2 ROMs are not supported. They never were.

**Mod Version**
Which version of the mod are you using?

**Describe the bug**
Be brief but descriptive.

**To Reproduce**
What did you do before and when the issue happened?
1. Do the thing...
2. Went there and there...
3. Did something else...
4. Everything exploded...

**Other installed mods (including disabled ones)**
List any other mods you had installed at the time the issue happened.
If there is anything on this list, please scroll back to the top and read the BEFORE YOU REPORT A BUG section again before you waste time filling out and submitting the rest of this form.
